# 2.38 Installable, offline tracker: lane notes

## Plan of the whole step (three parts)

- **Part 1, the device holds the game (builder 1).** (a) "Your games" lists every game this device holds plays for that the server lacks, however old, with Dismiss that asks first: `queue-storage.ts` (`leagueId`, `listAll`, `forget`), `held-games.ts`, `held-games-panel.tsx`, `my-games-page.tsx`, `tracker.held.*` messages; tests in `held-games.test.ts` and the queue storage contract. (b) The controller starts from the state, rosters and scoring session kept on the device when the server does not answer, and settles when it does (M5; T-248, T-253): `opened-game-storage.ts` (+ memory and IndexedDB) keeps the session id, cleared with the game; `open-tracker-game.ts`, `tracker-controller.ts`; tests beside each. (c) L9: the tracker's download slimmed, measured before and after.
- **Part 2, installable and opens with no signal (builder 2).** The web app manifest and icons (`apps/web/public`, the tracker's page head), a service worker that stores only the tracker's pages and code (T-115) and replaces them only when no game is open on the device (T-127, T-158); its pure rules (what is stored, when to update) in a module with unit tests; `scripts/check-web-shell.mjs` rows if a route is added.
- **Part 3, proven in a browser (builder 3).** `tests/browser/tracker-offline-test.mjs`: load the tracker, go offline before the reload, reload, keep scoring; taps accepted when the network returns if nobody took the game, listed not saved if somebody did; signing out clears the kept games; a new release waits until the open game is closed; pictures at phone and tablet width; the scoring-screen checklist lines of `docs/build/audits/live-scoring.md` answered; the area lead's review.
